title: Conectores formales: a raíz de, en el marco de

sections.content: A raíz de introduces a cause ('as a result of'); en el marco de sets a broader context or framework something happened within ('within the context of'). Together they let a paragraph explain both why something happened and what larger situation it was part of. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: A raíz de más de una década de guerra casi continua, las nuevas repúblicas heredaron economías devastadas.
items.english: As a result of more than a decade of almost continuous war, the new republics inherited devastated economies.

items.spanish: En el marco de este colapso económico, varios gobiernos solicitaron préstamos a bancos británicos.
items.english: Within the context of this economic collapse, several governments requested loans from British banks.

items.spanish: Esa burbuja, en el marco de la primera gran crisis financiera internacional moderna, se desplomó en 1825.
items.english: That bubble, within the context of the first great modern international financial crisis, collapsed in 1825.

items.spanish: A raíz de la exclusión sistemática de los criollos de los puestos más altos, había relativamente poca gente con experiencia de gobierno.
items.english: As a result of the systematic exclusion of criollos from the highest posts, there were relatively few people with governing experience.

sections.content: En el marco de doesn't claim direct causation the way a raíz de does — it just says 'this is the larger situation this fits inside.' Use it when you want to place an event in context without necessarily arguing that context caused it.
